catalog.status: 256 authored editable titles; contextual shortlist and persistent series usage helpers. Full character/video executor remains future.
authority: User approves dynamic Title wheel based on previous results,12 contextual +4 receh with equal final probabilities.
User requests200++ titles and disabling each title after it is spun for a character.

wheel.label: Gelar
wheel.candidatePolicy: Required predicates first; unused contextual candidates ranked by matched actual affinity tags, seed only breaks ties; receh ranks by seed. Equalizer suppresses soft affinities.
wheel.finalProbability: Uniform over frozen shortlist.16 leaves normally6.25% each. No numeric stat5%/25% bounds here.
wheel.smallPool: Use up to12 contextual and4 receh from actual remaining eligible entries. Never reuse or invent titles to fill vacancies.
wheel.exhaustion: No eligible unused title: exhausted/needs catalogue expansion; no automatic reset.
wheel.singleton: Direct reveal without RNG; consume selected title once, no actual funny-spin hook.

usageContract.scope: One persistent explicit series; default roda-kekacauan-main across all characters/runs.
usageContract.disableWhen: Atomic committed Title result, before hidden event children.
usageContract.titleIdentity: Stable canonical titleId, not AI-generated spelling; aliases/wording never bypass an existing claim.
usageContract.perCharacter: Exactly one title per [runId,characterId]; replay resumes its saved receipt without new RNG.
usageContract.preview: Separate browser demo state only. Production series registry remains untouched.
usageContract.reset: Never reset automatically, even on exhaustion or catalogue version updates. User must explicitly request a new series/reset.
usageContract.claimAndReceipt: Atomically persist unique title claim and replayable hidden-effect receipt under one lock.
usageContract.concurrent: Exclusive lock serializes plan+draw+claim; stale externally frozen pools fail rather than redraw.

effectsContract.default: Lore only; epithet wording never grants equipment/power or changes earlier results.
effectsContract.hidden: 24 predefined small effects:20 stat+1,2 scoped Weapon Mastery+1,2 shared Power Mastery+1.
effectsContract.timing: Reveal after committed title; registered source-once modifiers settle at final phase.
effectsContract.weapons: Hidden weapon mastery uses one active owned weapon, uniform selection/direct reveal; ordinary final Enchant gate only.
effectsContract.powers: Reuse existing one shared mastery. No added power, extra mastery roll or Power Enchant.
effectsContract.funny: Only an actual explicitly tagged funny Title spin can supply existing Shrek hook; preview/replay/fixed reveal does not.
effectsContract.generator: AI may narrate/describe chosen canonical title. New names/bonuses require catalogue updates; no free-form stat grant.

contextContract.source: Completed committed owner context through Roda Kekacauan; no future Title/Enchant evidence.
contextContract.proofAdapter: Existing stat context validates race/role/Backstory/normal Size and active owned inventory; completed source-backed stat bases and final-only pre-Title modifiers give provisional values.
contextContract.observations: Pre-Title projections are not settled final stats; no original raw result/probability is changed.
contextContract.affinity: Canonical race/role/result/Backstory tokens plus known owned weapon/power tags, Size and distinct actual stat signatures.
contextContract.unknown: Unrecognized equipment/power affinities stay neutral, never inferred from labels. Specialty titles with missing proof remain ineligible.
